made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/subida-sheet-make.js, from subida-set.html (window.SUBIDA.E) and the design of El camino al fuerte (the orchestrator's p10-spec, general rules and section subida). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 104. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the fort's wall at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 104 + 13 v - 22.5 z; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the ground; z 2.5: the battlements' top at the wall; z 0.2: the flat stone's top; z 0.74: the table's top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): the basket, the dish, the jugs, the ball and the three lanterns by the gate have their bottom middle on the spot, the three hooks' lanterns and the paper hang by their top middle, the flag has its left middle on the pole, the hammock its middle (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy - h, w, h] for a bottom one; [sx - floor(w / 2), sy, w, h] for a hanging one; [sx, sy - floor(h / 2), w, h] for the flag; [sx - floor(w / 2), sy - floor(h / 2), w, h] for the hammock). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up, 40 for a child; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30; a small thing: see spot. Carmen "sitting by the tree" (arbol) is drawn standing. Whoever lies in the hammock is part of the hammock sprite (hamaca_dentro is the same point). Nobody is drawn turned
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character. The tree's leaves sway: the depth is the LIVE depth of the still frame (frame(0), t = 0), see front.how

The spec: x0 22 (the window centred on the picture) unless a spot is cut (a person with his sprite whole, a small thing with its box). x0 15 to 25 hold them all; x0 22 is the one nearest 22, the window centred on the picture (the spots held span columns 25 to 210). The window's point is the ground point under its middle column at the picture's middle row

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the set's depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the wall hides what is behind it, the table hides the legs of the guests behind it, the tree's trunk and leaves hide what is behind them. The set's depth is the baked depth (window.DEPTH.z) plus the tree's leaves at the still frame (t = 0: window.DEPTH.live() after frame(0)); with the wind the leaves move a pixel or two, so a sprite that shows at t = 0 may lose a pixel or two behind a leaf at another frame
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where the set's depth (window.DEPTH.live() of the set page after frame(0), for the moment's state) is more than depth(r) + bias. The same rule as El cruce's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28) (open point)
shadows.onSurface: the frog on the wall (muro_coqui), on the stone (piedra) casts none: neither is the ground (a shadow cast at the ground under him would show in front of him); the things on the table, on a hook, on the pole, on the trunk or hung between the posts cast none
